Creating this fitness test taught me how critical it is to match exercises with student developmental levels. Selecting more Exercises like Cardio Endurance — 3-Min Step Test, Agility Test, and Sit & Reach and this allowed not just the instructor but me also knowing to safely assess core strength and flexibility across different fitness baselines. This process showed me that a good fitness test must challenge students without discouraging them or causing injury.
